Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (1)Firm should qoute only Make of "Godrej or Equivalent". (2) OEM Authorization - The bidder shall submit a Bid Specific Authorization directly from OEM as per Railw ay Board Guidelines and the Purchaser shall confirm the genuineness of OEM Authorization. (3) The bidder must submit point-wise (para-wise) technical compliance of the offered product along with t he BID, failing which the offer is liable to be summarily rejected. (4) Firm shall attach following certifications with offer. Certificate shall be valid on date of opening of bid a nd shall be in the name of same manufacturer as of offered product. The certificate authenticity shall be v erifiable on official sites. Any Certification through 3rd party will not be applicable. Company/Seller should be NABCB certified: (i) ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018. (ii) The offered manufacturer must possess valid BIFMA membership, and the same shall be verifiable excl usively through the official BIFMA website (https://www.bifma.org). (iii) OEM should be Indian Green Building Council (IGBC) Platinum certified. (iv) AIOTA certification for ergonomics. (5) Past Performance - Firm shall submit past performance as per GeM clause for minimum 20% bid quanti ty. Firms need to provide CRAC/Receipt Note/Inspection Certificate/CRN/Receipt Challan (Signed by Bu yer Representative) for item of same GeM catalogue/category to serve as proof of supply status for Past Perfor mance. Proof of supply should clearly indicate quantity supplied and date of supply. Only copy of purch ase order, GeM Contract, self-signed tax invoice, self-made performance statement will not establish that supply has been completed. (6) Firm must upload the certificate, mentioning the percentage of local content in the material being offer ed. Please enter 0 for fully imported items, and 100 for fully indigenous items. The definition and Calculatio n of local content shall be in accordance with the Make in India policy. The firm has to certify that the item offered meets the minimum local content and shall give details of the locations at which the local value ad dition is made. (7) Certificate - Firm shall submit the OEM's Guarantee/Warranty Certificate at the time of supply. . 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
